title: Messy Bedroom Still Life
description: A top-down view of a cluttered bedroom with yellow walls and wooden floors. Visible items include an unmade bed with black comforter and a red 'JASON IS REAL' bag, a wooden desk covered in bottles, books, and a monitor with green code, a black office chair with blue clothing, scattered toys, a potted plant, and a white door.
prompt: Top-down photograph of a messy teenage bedroom with bright yellow walls and light wood flooring. An ornate wooden bed with black rumpled comforter holds a red bag that says JASON IS REAL. A wooden desk is covered in empty bottles, books, a monitor displaying green code, and various items. Black office chair has blue clothing on it. Scattered on the floor are toys, papers, a potted plant, and cables. White door stands open revealing a hallway.
